items.title: SpaceX ETF Frenzy Reaches 'Bonkers' Levels As Volume Surges Past $1 Billion
items.summary: Following SpaceX's IPO, ten leveraged ETFs launched on Monday, generating over $1 billion in trading volume. Multiple issuers including ProShares, Tradr, Leverage Shares, Defiance, GraniteShares, REX Shares, and Direxion rushed to capitalize on investor demand for amplified exposure to SPCX. A fee war emerged among competitors, with expense ratios ranging from 0.75% to 2.20%. The existing Tema Space Innovators ETF also saw significant inflows of $146 million on Monday.

items.title: Move Over, Bitcoin: New SpaceX ETF Just Doubled IBIT's Historic Debut
items.summary: Following SpaceX's IPO, the Leverage Shares 2X Long SPCX Daily ETF (SPCH) generated $1.3 billion in day-two trading volume, surpassing Bitcoin Trust's previous record of $500 million. However, the article warns that leveraged ETFs like SPCH are designed for short-term trading only, as daily rebalancing creates volatility decay that can result in losses even when the underlying stock breaks even over time.

items.title: 'No One Is Buying SPCX On Fundamentals': Reddit's Playbook For The SpaceX Stock Mania
items.summary: SpaceX's IPO debut has driven massive retail investor speculation despite fundamental concerns. Reddit traders are openly acknowledging they're buying on hype rather than valuation, with Morningstar valuing the company at $780 billion versus its $1.77 trillion IPO price. The stock has gained roughly $800 billion in market cap in two trading days, driven by sentiment and psychology rather than financial metrics, mirroring the Tesla trading phenomenon.

Direxion has launched a leveraged 2X bull ETF (LOFF) for SpaceX, mirroring its successful Tesla ETF (TSLL) strategy. Multiple other providers including ProShares, GraniteShares, REX Shares, Leverage Shares, and Defiance ETFs are also rolling out similar SpaceX-linked leveraged products, intensifying competition in the growing single-stock ETF market.

items.title: GraniteShares Announces Forward Splits
items.summary: GraniteShares announced forward stock splits for seven 2X leveraged daily ETFs effective June 26, 2026. The splits range from 3-for-1 to 25-for-1, increasing outstanding shares by 200% to 2,400%. The splits are non-taxable events with no transaction fees for shareholders. Ticker symbols and CUSIP numbers remain unchanged.

items.title: 2X Acquires Knownwell to Build the First GTM Human-Agentic Services Company Unifying B2B Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success
items.summary: 2X announced the acquisition of Knownwell, an AIaaS platform specializing in agentic AI engineering and commercial intelligence. The combined company is valued at over $400 million and aims to create a unified B2B go-to-market operating system. David DeWolf, Knownwell's founder and CEO, has been appointed as 2X's new CEO, while 2X founder Dom Colasante remains active in the business.

items.title: Tech Stocks' Relief Rally Crumbles: SOXL Craters 15%, AMD Sheds 6% As Recovery Fizzles
items.summary: A brief morning rally in technology stocks collapsed Tuesday as sellers reasserted control. The Semiconductor ETF (SOXL) plunged 16.43%, while chip stocks including AMD, Broadcom, and Qualcomm fell sharply. Experts attributed the selloff to a rotation out of tech ahead of SpaceX's Friday IPO debut. Only Meta managed modest gains while most large-cap tech stocks declined.

items.title: Alterra IOS Secures $244M Financing to Fuel Growth of National Industrial Outdoor Storage Platform
items.summary: Alterra IOS closed a $244 million loan from Blackstone Real Estate Debt Strategies to support its industrial outdoor storage platform expansion. The financing, secured by 37 properties across 27 markets, brings Alterra's total institutional debt to over $1.8 billion. This marks Blackstone's sixth IOS sector loan, with total exposure exceeding $1.1 billion. Alterra has acquired over 470 properties across 39 states using an innovative equity pledge framework instead of traditional mortgage structures.
